product.productName: Stagg EKG Electric Kettle — Pro / Woodland + Walnut
features: Precision gooseneck spout for slow, controlled pouring.
To-the-degree temperature control from 104°F to 212°F (40°C to 100°C).
Scheduled heating and adjustable temperature hold for 15, 30, 45, or 60 minutes.
0.9 L (30 oz) capacity and 1000–1200W heating system.
Full-color display, control dial, preset brewing temperatures, and built-in brew stopwatch.
WiFi firmware updates through the EKG Updater app.
benefits: Take more control of your morning pour-over by choosing your water temperature and pouring at a steady pace.
Schedule hot water around your routine instead of starting the kettle when you're ready to brew.
Keep water hot while you take your time brewing.
Use temperature presets and a built-in timer for guidance when you're learning.
claims: “The ultimate pour-over kettle, built for precision and control.”
1200 watts delivers a quick heat time.
Precision pour spout supports accurate pouring and even saturation.
proofPoints: Scraped review data reports a 4.6 rating from 2,225 reviews; the rating scale is not explicitly provided.
Page lists ETL compliance, FCC certification, CSA certification, and UL compliance.
Published specifications include a 0.9 L capacity, 40°C–100°C temperature range, and 1000–1200W power rating.
useCases: Scheduling hot water ahead of a morning coffee routine.
Heating water for tea using preset temperatures.
Timing pour-over brewing or tea steeping.
product.positioning: A precision-focused countertop kettle for making your daily pour-over feel more deliberate and less like guesswork.
constraints: Use only with its electric base; never on a stovetop or induction surface.
Use fresh, clean water only. Milk or other liquids may scald and will void the warranty.
Listed electrical configuration is 110–120V with a Type-B plug for the U.S. and Canada.
The EKG Updater app provides firmware updates, not remote control of the kettle or its settings.
Studio Edition glass-base and metal-accent details should not be attributed to the selected Pro variant.
Warranty is described as two years standard with an option to extend; do not imply an unconditional longer warranty.
riskFlags: Page includes a California Proposition 65 warning but does not provide its specific substance or exposure details.
The pre-boil feature is described as sanitizing water; do not imply it makes contaminated water safe or guarantees sterilization.
“Ultimate” and “perfected” are unsupported superiority language, not verified performance conclusions.
Quick heating and precise temperature maintenance are manufacturer claims; no timed heating test or independent accuracy results are supplied.
Listed certifications and compliance statements are page-reported, not independently verified.
Do not treat the reference to world brewing champions as an endorsement or evidence of professional use.
sourceNotes: Primary product is the selected Stagg EKG Pro / Woodland + Walnut at $199.95.
The comparison table lists the pour-over model at $179.95; that price is not clearly tied to the selected finish and was not used.
Page also shows Pro Studio Edition, other kettle comparisons, bundles, and promotional mentions of other products.
Country-selector entries and page-refresh text in bulletPoints were excluded as scrape noise.
One review entry contains a parsing error; the separate readable entry supplies the 4.6 rating and 2,225 review count. No individual testimonials were provided.
No independent performance testing or certification documents were supplied.

scriptStrategy.reason: The angle names a clear frustration and a directly supported solution. Keep agitation brief so the 15-second talking-head video has room to show temperature selection and a controlled pour.
scriptStrategy.coreMessage: Choosing your water temperature and controlling your pour can make your morning pour-over feel more intentional and less like guesswork.
scriptStrategy.mainObjection: Does this offer enough control beyond my current kettle to justify $199.95? Show the specific controls rather than claiming it is worth the price for everyone.
scriptStrategy.emotionalDirection: Move from mild brewing frustration to calm, practical confidence in a familiar morning ritual. Keep Marcus relaxed and conversational, without coffee snobbery or promises of perfect coffee.
requiredProof: Use the listed to-the-degree temperature control from 104°F to 212°F as support; show temperature selection on the display, not an unverified temperature-accuracy test.
Support the listed precision gooseneck spout with a close-up of a slow, controlled pour. Do not imply independently proven taste improvement.
requiredProductMoments: 0–4 seconds: Establish the selected Stagg EKG Pro in Woodland + Walnut on its electric base beside Marcus as he introduces the brewing frustration.
4–8 seconds: Keep the kettle visible while explaining the core benefit; show Marcus using its dial to select a water temperature.
8–12 seconds: Show Marcus holding the kettle naturally by its handle and pouring water over a pour-over brewer, with the spout and stream clearly visible.
12–15 seconds: Return to Marcus with the kettle visible beside the brewer for the better-routine takeaway and brief CTA.
